title: HyperpowersConfig
description: Project and user configuration settings for the Hyperpowers agent framework.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON schema for validation.

mode.description: Default plan execution mode. 'hybrid' runs sequential tasks inline and independent batches concurrently; 'sdd' isolates every task in a subagent workspace; 'inline' runs all tasks sequentially in the active session.

taskCap.description: Maximum number of atomic tasks per implementation plan before phase-splitting into milestones.

watchdogTimeoutSeconds.description: Watchdog timer interval in seconds before testing subagent liveness.

circuitBreakerThreshold.description: Number of consecutive failed fix attempts before the circuit breaker triggers and halts speculative edits.

targetedInnerLoop.description: When true, runs only the targeted test file during RED-GREEN-REFACTOR inner cycles, reserving full suite runs for final completion.

quietByDefault.description: When true, applies quiet flags (e.g. pytest -q, cargo test -- -q) to prevent log flooding in context windows.

visual.description: Visual verification and UI testing settings.

telemetry.description: When false, completely disables all optional external badge and network requests.
